search.snippet: padkavanymi nahami. [original: “One, two, three, four tracks,” said Mowgli, stooping over the ashes. “Four tracks of men with shod feet...”] 1941 [1865], Mayne

search.snippet: mokrata zemja i bavno se otdalečavaše kăm gorata. The dog was sniffing the tracks on the wet ground and slowly moving away toward the forest. Ловното куче
